ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (~80% coverage) with high-intensity white clusters (~20%) localized primarily at the margins and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs are mapped along the entire superior trailing edge of both lobes. Two distinct circular white spots are located immediately lateral to the median notch. A diffuse light-gray/white gradient is visible on the distal half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured aperture of approximately 50 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple high-amplitude peaks correspond to white calcified clusters, alternating with deep dark valleys along the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a jagged, stepped curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular white high-contrast pixels (barnacle scars) are concentrated along the trailing edge. A unique 'bullseye' rosette (white ring with dark center) is mapped on the distal-superior region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the central and right lobe regions, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive serration and irregular margin loss along the trailing edge; heavy scarring from linear rake marks and barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'eye-like' circular marking on the upper right lobe consisting of a dark pupil-like center surrounded by a high-intensity white ring.
